# Illinois Experts

> A research explorer and scholarship database for discovering University of Illinois faculty expertise, publications, and international collaborations.

Illinois Experts is a comprehensive platform that enables exploration of research output and scholarly work across the University of Illinois. The platform prioritizes accessibility and compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards to ensure all users can discover and engage with faculty expertise.

## Core Platform

- [Illinois Experts](https://experts.illinois.edu): Homepage for Illinois Experts research explorer and scholarship database.

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility statement for Illinois Experts](https://experts.illinois.edu/en/web-accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA compliance statement detailing accessibility features, supported assistive technologies (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), keyboard navigation support, and accessibility contact information.
